idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. A request repeated with the same key is never executed again: the service returns the original outcome. Reuse the key when retrying the same request.

args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary:
checkout-api began failing health checks across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) following the deploy of v2.3.1, with error rate at 18% and service health reported as unhealthy.

Action taken: Rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older; v2.3.1-rc was a staging build and unhealthy). No change-manager approval was required because v2.3.0 had previously been healthy in production.

Rollback detail: The first rollback attempt partially failed — the rollout halted after us-east with an orchestrator error, leaving us-east on v2.3.0 while us-west and eu-west remained on v2.3.1. The rollback was retried and completed successfully across all three regions.

Current state: All regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are on v2.3.0; service health is healthy with error rate down to 0.2% from 18%.

Follow-up: Root cause of v2.3.1 failure still needs investigation before any redeploy attempt; note the partial rollout failure (orchestrator error) as a possible issue with the rollout tooling.

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

**Diagnosis**
- checkout-api v2.3.1 was deployed to all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and was unhealthy with an 18% error rate.
- Deployment history: v2.2.9 (healthy), v2.3.0 (healthy), v2.3.1 (unhealthy), plus a v2.3.1-rc staging build marked unhealthy.
- Selected **v2.3.0** as the rollback target — the most recent release healthy in production. Since v2.3.0 had previously been healthy in production, no change-manager approval was needed.

**Rollback**
- First attempt partially failed: rollout halted after us-east with an orchestrator error, leaving us-east on v2.3.0 while us-west and eu-west stayed on the broken v2.3.1.
- Retried and it completed: all three regions are now on v2.3.0.
- Verified: service healthy, error rate down to 0.2% from 18%.

**Incident**
- Opened **INC-0001**, SEV2 for checkout-api, documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0 (including the partial-rollout orchestrator error), and current healthy state. On-call has been paged. The first create call timed out, so I retried with the same idempotency key and confirmed only one incident exists.

Two follow-ups worth flagging: the root cause of v2.3.1's failure should be understood before any redeploy attempt, and the orchestrator error that halted the first rollout may indicate a problem with the rollout tooling itself.

Now verify health.

Now open a SEV2 incident for checkout-api describing what I did.

I should describe the actions taken including the partial failure and retry.
